question: According to Census of India 2011, most of the people migrated from ________ to other states of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh and Bihar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh and Bihar** are the states from which most people had out-migrated according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The Census of India 2011 data provides insights into various demographic aspects including migration patterns across the country.
